Send Message Overview PROGRAMS People ABOUT US Social --> Cause Area Primary Sectors Other Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Tribes Specially Abled Child & Youth Development Senior Citizens Education Food & Nutrition Skill Development Secondary Sectors HIV/AIDS Micro Finance - Self Help Groups Women Empowerment Formal Education Child Rights Girl Child Scholarships Financials Geographies Served Programs Children's Home for the Destitute Boys District Bangalore Bangalore Rural State Karnataka District Bangalore Bangalore Rural States Karnataka The Adarane contributes to the development of children's rights. Give them a good education and a fulfilling life. The main focus of the trust is education, but systematic rural community empowerment, especially for women, is another important aspect of Adarane. Since 2008, Adarane has concentrated on helping kids whose parents are HIV+ and unable to provide them the love and care they need. We provide these motivated kids with a home, food, and a quality education when we adopt them. We currently have four of these kids at our children's home, giving them a fresh start in life. 30 semi orphans are now housed at our centre. Our goal is to serve 60 kids in the upcoming year. ADARANE SAMRUDHI EVENING STUDY CENTRE District Bangalore Bangalore Rural State Karnataka District Bangalore Bangalore Rural States Karnataka Aims to give kids living in rural locations access to extra schooling. The standard of instruction provided in rural Karnataka and Tamil Nadu schools is far from adequate, and it never helps the pupils from these areas compete with those from urban and semi-urban areas. It is becoming a major cause for concern and the main reason why most students drop out. A few years ago, the Evening Study Centre was established with this goal in mind. Children in Evening Study Centres complete their schoolwork under the guidance of tutors. Many kids don't have literate parents who can't assist them with schoolwork. As a result, kids do worse in school and have worse self-esteem, and some of them finally quit going to school altogether. Evening Study Centres have reduced the dropout rate and helped keep kids in school. it also gives away school supplies to underprivileged kids, such as notebooks and pens. Milestones & Track Record Since 2008, Adarane has focused on helping children whose parents are HIV-positive. They have expanded to 42 free coaching centers across multiple areas, helping over 1,600 underprivileged students. --> --> Leadership Team Guru Prasad.M Founder and President SHIVA KUMAR T Trustee RAVI CHANDRA Treasurer Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AADTA6274H Registration Number BNS-4-00554 CSR Form 1 CSR00006388 VO ID / Darpan ID KA/2017/0156449 --> 80G AADTA6274HF20210 12A AADTA6274HE20212 FCRA Nill About Headquarters Bangalore, Karnataka Since 2005 Demographies Served Women Children Senior Citizens Girls Scheduled Castes Scheduled Tribes Specially Abled --> Impact Adarane has helped over 30 orphaned and semi-orphaned children at their children's home, providing them with shelter, food, education and a new hope for the future. Vision and Mission Adarane's vision is a world where every human being is loved, cared for and not deprived of basic necessities. Their mission is to mainstream destitute and underprivileged children by providing love, care, education and support to ensure they are not deprived of basic needs.
